title: Route the anth.us engage page into Prospectus intake and retire the Google Form
description:
Ryan, 2026-10-17 portfolio review: the first outside contact arrives through a form, and the anth.us contact path is a Google Form today, which undercuts the pitch. Wire the anth.us engage page into Prospectus contact/demo intake and retire the Google Form once intake works end to end.

Feature: anth.us contact reaches Prospectus
  Scenario: Visitor sends a demo request from anth.us
    Given Prospectus intake is enabled for real contacts
    When a visitor submits the anth.us engage form
    Then one durable inquiry appears in Prospectus with its source and receipt
    And the visitor no longer reaches the Google Form

Depends on kanbus-67ae2d79 (real-contact intake readiness). Invitations kanbus-b2ddb42a follow this.

comments.author: home
comments.text: 2026-10-19 (verified): scenario satisfied. AnthusAI/Anth.us-web#74 (merged ef00dbd) replaced the Google Form on https://anth.us/engage/ with a form posting to Prospectus intake (notice contact-v1); Anth.us-web#79 (merged 87d5af7) styled it and added an info@anth.us fallback. No Google Form links remain on anth.us. Prospectus#43 (merged 4317089, Amplify job 41 SUCCEED) fixed the production 503 by creating control claims first instead of reading absent keys without ListBucket; no IAM change. At 20:45 UTC a labelled test submission from anth.us/engage returned 202 with receipt 0714f32b-c9fa-4621-976e-c96240619ff8; intake wrote its receipt and identity claims, invoked prospectus-api, and created canonical prospect prsp-964cd0ea-a2c7-44d4-870c-aa835e02216d (cyclotron/prospectus/project/issues/..., 20:45:49 UTC). That record is a test contact Ryan may archive.
